INSERT INTO vehicle_error (
               vehicle_id, created_at, name, tags, body, record_created_at, received_at
           )
           SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
               $1::smallint[], $2::timestamptz[], $3::text[], $4::jsonb[], $5::text[],
               $6::timestamptz[], $7::timestamptz[]
           )
           ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
